name: Clover
long_description: We built a new style of text editor from the ground up to better support creative thinking. Clover lets you explode traditional, linear documents into an infinite "surface" for a more intuitive, visual way of note-taking, brainstorming, mind-mapping, and managing tasks.
one_liner: The all-in-one notebook for creatives to brainstorm, write, and plan…

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio:
Currently working on Clover. Previously led a team working on design tools at InVision. Founded Macaw, which InVision acquired in 2015. Also worked at nclud designing products for Apple and Oracle. In 2012, I went to Twitter by way of an acquihire. I left shortly after to help MIT design and launch edX.
